title: Finance: Exchange Rates
summary: Reading exchange-rate tables, converting between currencies, buying and selling rates and commission, the effect of a strong or weak rand, and comparing prices internationally.

notes.text: An **exchange rate** tells you how much one currency is worth in another. If US\$1 = R18,50, then something costing US\$40 costs 40 × R18,50 = R740.

items: **Foreign currency → rand**: multiply by the rate.
**Rand → foreign currency**: divide by the rate.

notes.title: Worked example 1
notes.problem: Thabo has R12 000 to take on holiday to Europe. How many euros will he get at R20,10 per euro?

notes.text: Banks **sell** foreign currency to you at a higher rate and **buy** it back from you at a lower rate. They may also charge **commission**, a percentage fee.

notes.title: Worked example 2
notes.problem: A bank sells US dollars at R18,90 and charges 1,5% commission. How much will US\$500 cost?

headers: Rand strengthens (e.g. R18 → R16 per US\$)
Rand weakens (e.g. R18 → R20 per US\$)
rows: Less competitive; exporters earn fewer rand
More competitive; exporters earn more rand
South Africa is more expensive for them
South Africa is cheaper for them

notes.title: Worked example 3: comparing prices
notes.problem: A pair of sneakers costs £85 in London and R2 150 in Johannesburg. Where are they cheaper? (£1 = R23,60)
notes.answer: Cheaper in London (by R144), before any shipping or duties

notes.label: Exam tip
notes.text: Always check which way the rate is given: 'rand per dollar' (R18,50 = US\$1) or 'dollars per rand' (US\$0,054 = R1). They are reciprocals of each other.

questions.prompt: A game costs US\$60 online. At R18,50 per US dollar, what is the price in rand?
How many British pounds can you buy with R5 900 at R23,60 per pound?
A hotel in Botswana costs P850 per night. What is this in rand at R1,36 per pula?
If the rand weakens against the US dollar, imported petrol becomes…
A weaker rand helps South African exporters earn more rand for their goods.
If R1 = US\$0,05, how many rand is US\$1 worth?
A bank sells euros at R20,40 and charges 2% commission. Calculate the cost of buying €300.
A laptop costs US\$899 in New York and R17 999 in Cape Town. At R18,50 per dollar, where is it cheaper and by how much?
Last year US\$1 = R17,20. This year US\$1 = R18,92. Calculate the percentage change, and say whether the rand strengthened or weakened.
